text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
...And now, the moment you've all been 
waiting for: the announcement.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Chosen as the "Umamusume of the Year," 
symbolizing this year's Twinkle Series, 
is—

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind top finishes across 
numerous GⅠ races packed with fierce 
contenders, she's an Umamusume who 
displayed the true majesty of the 
"Empress"!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: It's Air Groove-san!!
(Clap clap clap clap clap...!)

"Taiki Shuttle's challenge began with the 
Shinzan Kinen—"

Her achievements recognized, Taiki Shuttle 
was awarded the Best Sprinter/Miler award.

"...Still, the road to becoming 'Horse 
Girl of the Year' was steep after all."

"Should I have run in more races? Should I 
have taken on distances beyond the mile?"

I was supposed to have done everything I 
could, and yet... I can't stop thinking 
thoughts like that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see the press conference?! 
Air Groove-senpai is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume of the Year," right?! Of course 
I watched it!! Air Groove-senpai really is 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right on~!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth, this year was packed 
with powerhouses, so it wouldn't have been 
weird no matter who won."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Grass Wonder-san in the Junior 
division, and Mejiro Dober-san in the 
Classic division...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And then there's Taiki Shuttle-san in the 
sprint division. ...Every single one of 
them is a formidable powerhouse far ahead 
of the rest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... the honor of "Umamusume of the 
Year" can't be seized by mere strength 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Just like you, Senpai, I'll take on crazy 
fierce battles and wild, massive stages—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"And only by lingering in everyone's 
hearts are you chosen for the first time, 
huh! Nngh, that's so cool...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeah, now that's a title worthy of 
yours truly!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah? What are you even talking about!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The one who performs the best and leaves 
the biggest mark this year! Is obviously 
gonna be ME!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say? Ha, wanna settle 
this in a race then?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Bring it on...!!

An Umamusume who "remains in the hearts" 
of the people—

"Is it really that difficult to leave a 
lasting impression on the sprint and mile 
stages after all?"

Still carrying those unsettled feelings, 
she arrived at the track for training—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And so! Let's run, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And just when I thought she tackled me out 
of nowhere... Taiki-senpai really hasn't 
changed one bit~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'd be happy to take you on. 
Looking forward to it~."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Fukukitaru! Let's run together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san?! What are you doing all of a 
sudden...! I was just walking by, you 
know?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It is a fateful encounter! Very lucky! Now 
then, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Lady Shiraoki's oracle says 'it's 
best to spend the afternoon relaxing'...!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, that was a good sweat. Who should 
be my next target...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wait, yo! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, toooo late. We've already started 
training, y'know~?

Taiki Shuttle is in her usual high 
spirits... or rather, even more energetic 
than usual.

However, the title of "Umamusume of the 
Year" is no longer something you can reach 
by just staying positive and working hard—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer!! Listen to me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Please, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
For the next year, please enter me in as 
many Sprint and Mile GⅠ races as possible.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In all of them—I will be number one! I 
shall show you that I can seize the very 
top, yes-sir.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Last year, my Trainer recommended it, so I 
ran in Sprints and Miles, yes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer. How was my race?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Not fantastic? Not exciting?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To me, the current me is fantastic & 
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I shall win. In any contest of 
speed, I shall conquer all!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And take my power and speed even higher! 
Further!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Delivering this straight to everyone's 
hearts, desu!!!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Life is what you make it！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I will keep moving forward! Even on an 
untrodden path, I'll carve a way through!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
With these legs that Trainer believed 
in... and that I myself am proud of!!
Right—

The one who declared her power and speed 
to be peerless was none other than me, her 
Trainer.
And yet...
choice_data_list: (If I don't believe in her, who will...!)
(If I don't believe in her, who will...!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer! Please tell me your 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Do you still believe in me and will you 
follow me?
choice_data_list:
Next time, you'll definitely become the 
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ――YEEEEEEEEE-HAW!! YES, YES, YEEEEES!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer!! Next year for sure...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Catch the dream!! Let's become the 
"Umamusume of the Year"!!

"...First up is the Yasuda Kinen, to 
decide the spring mile champion!"
